title: The Surprise Thread
logline: 5pm, two hours before a surprise 30th: the group chat is on fire, the decor and the cake are still in the bag, and the friend who promised to do both just walked in from work running on empty. Her reply to the thread is {product}.

world.setting: Leah's small apartment in Toronto on a Friday, 5pm to 7pm, and the group chat 'Jules turns 30' that is planning his surprise party there. One quick cutaway to Omar in his parked car.
world.palette: Built from the can: white and silver kitchen, sky-blue and silver balloons, outgoing chat bubbles in sky blue #6EC1E4; the payoff adds warm string-light amber.
fictional_brands: the chat app is generic and unnamed (no app name, no logo, a clean neutral UI built in code)
Jules turns 30 (the group chat name, post only)
world.rules: Every phone screen in the live action is dark and blank; all UI, bubbles, names and notifications are rendered in code. Balloons, garland and cake carry no writing. The only real brand is the product.

beats.summary: A phone buzzing face-up on a counter; notification banners stack in: guests at 7, is Leah still on decor and cake, Jules left work early.
Leah walks in from work and reads it; her reply: running on empty. Omar sends a voice note from his car. She types 'hold on' and opens the fridge.
The can from the fridge door, the crack, the sip, the line. Her reply lands: ok. i'm on it.
Montage with ticks firing into the chat: balloons done, cake done, lights done. Omar: who ARE you.
String lights, the door opens, everyone jumps out; Jules can't believe it.
She sends one last photo to the thread: the can by the cake. Caption: wiiings without sugar.

music.brief: Sparse, curious plucked synth and finger snaps, 112 bpm in F major, leaves space for buzzes and pops, a small tension riser under the fridge door.
Drops in fully on the can crack: bouncy upbeat indie-pop with claps and a bass line, each montage tick lands on a beat.
Cuts to silence for one beat as the door opens, explodes on Surprise with a big chorus lift, then settles warm under the photo message and tagline.
